species.name: Scorpion
mustRead: pincer claws held forward on long arms
segmented tail arched over the back ending in a sting
flat broad body on eight legs
species.note: the eyes are tiny and sit on top of the carapace - the pincers, not the face, carry the expression

species.name: Deer Tick
mustRead: eight legs bunched toward the front
flat teardrop unsegmented body
barbed spear mouthparts jutting ahead
species.note: Almost always drawn from above; in true side profile an unfed tick is a very low flat wedge. Eight legs, not six.

species.name: Spider
mustRead: two-part body: small front section and large round abdomen
eight jointed legs arching up then down
legs all attached to the front section only
species.note: Generic name read as a representative orb-weaver/house spider. Legs must all spring from the front body part, never from the abdomen.

species.name: Camel Spider
mustRead: enormous forward-jutting pincer jaws
long leg-like pedipalps held out in front like extra legs
hairy segmented tan abdomen
species.note: Not a true spider: no tail, no venom fangs, and it appears to have ten legs because the palps are held forward as feelers.

species.name: Harvestman
mustRead: single pea-like body with no waist
eight thread-thin legs many times body length
tiny eye turret on top of body
species.note: Not a spider: one fused body segment, no silk, no separate abdomen.

species.name: Pseudoscorpion
mustRead: oversized scorpion-like pincer arms held forward
flat teardrop segmented abdomen
no tail and no sting
species.note: Commonly drawn with a stinging tail - it has none; the abdomen ends bluntly.

species.name: Mite
mustRead: featureless bag-like unsegmented body
eight short legs bunched at the front
tiny protruding mouth cone
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a typical dust/velvet mite. No waist, no separate head, no visible eyes.

species.name: Sea Spider
mustRead: body reduced to a thin stick between the legs
enormously long spindly legs holding the organs
long tubular sucking proboscis at the front
species.note: Not a spider - the body is so shrunken the gut and gonads extend into the legs; four eyes sit on a small turret.
